name: Big Mek in Mega Armour
unitComposition:
• 1 Big Mek in Mega Armour model
This model is equipped with: 1 Kustom Shoota; 1 Power Klaw.

abilities.name: Fix Dat Armour Up (Once per battle, per unit)
abilities.rules: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds. Place a Grot Oiler token next to the unit, removing it when this ability is used.

abilities.lore: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
abilities.name: Leader
abilities.rules: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: More Dakka
abilities.rules:
This unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Ignores Cover].
  • If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

rules.name: Leader
rules.rules:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ **MEGANOBZ**
■ **MEK GUNZ**

abilities.name: LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE
abilities.rules: Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

abilities.name: RAPID FIRE 2
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [RAPID FIRE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. Example: If a [RAPID FIRE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).

abilities.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS
abilities.rules:
Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using close‑quarters shooting (10.06). When using another shooting type, for each model in that unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with:
  • One or more of its [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapons.
  • One or more of its other ranged weapons.

abilities.name: TORRENT
abilities.rules: Each time an attack is made with a [TORRENT] weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

wargearItem.name: Kustom Force Field
wargearItem.ruleText: This unit has 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

abilities.name: BLAST 1
abilities.rules: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], each time you gather attack dice for such a weapon, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. Example: If a [BLAST 2] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).

abilities.rules: Each time a unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of hazard rolls (06.03) for that unit equal to the number of [HAZARDOUS] weapons you selected in the Select Weapons step.
